descriptionHtml:
Dominate modern gaming and heavy multitasking with the ASUS TUF Gaming A16 FA607NUQ-RL007W! Equipped with an 8-core AMD Ryzen 7 170 processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 6GB graphics with MUX Switch, and a fast 16.0 inch FHD+ 144Hz display in a durable Mecha Gray chassis, this laptop delivers high frame rates and military-grade toughness.
